entities.summary: DHL de Guatemala Flight 7216 was an international cargo flight between Costa Rica's Juan Santamaría International Airport and Guatemala City's La Aurora International Airport. On 7 April 2022 , the Boeing 757 suffered a hydraulic failure, and crashed on landing at the Costa Rican airport. Neither of the two pilots was injured.
